# Decisions

Rules that span modules, from each package's `Decisions:`. Owner rules end with `(owner)`.

## Owner

- `authorlm.audio`: Export resolves explicitly configured per-paragraph voices from the manuscript's `_audio/audiobook.toml` and cast into the shared manifest; both consumers use those resolved parameters. Enforced by: tests/test_audio_voice_config.py::VoiceConfigTests::test_required_voice_fields_are_not_filled_in and tests/test_audio_voice_config.py::VoiceConfigTests::test_chapter_override_is_exact_file_without_inheritance. (owner)
- `authorlm.audio`: Mac say previews and export do not require an ElevenLabs Voice ID; paid synthesis does. Explicit cast roles remain required. Enforced by tests/test_audio_preview_without_paid_voice.py. (owner)
- `authorlm.devedit`: A letter is written at the end of each stage, over every stage so far (never the stages still to come), and judges what that much of the book delivers against what it promises, maps every concept as introduced, asserted, demonstrated or assumed, and lists at most ten problems, each with evidence, why it matters, a remedy and its dependencies. (owner)
- `authorlm.devedit`: Coverage comes from `toc.toml` and is confirmed by the author before any step runs; only files the TOC lists are covered, and `outside` files never are. (owner)
- `authorlm.devedit`: Each letter decision is binding or provisional; a later step may raise a provisional one for reconsideration, never override either. (owner)
- `authorlm.devedit`: Run state lives in the manuscript folder, `_devedit/<run-id>/`, beside `_critiques`, and travels with the manuscript. (owner)
- `authorlm.devedit`: Strengths the letter names are preserved, not frozen: a later step may move a strong passage or add a transition, never weaken what makes it strong. (owner)
- `authorlm.devedit`: The integrator reads every proposed item together after the essay agents, from a deterministic grouping by term, concept, dependency and paragraph, and makes the items mutually consistent. (owner)
- `authorlm.gdocs`: A tab's anchor in the whole-Doc export is its opening heading (level and text), the split backs up over any epigraph paragraphs before it, and opening headings must be unique across tabs and must not recur as a heading in an earlier tab; the pull stops and names the pair otherwise. Why: first-paragraph anchors let a short dialogue line ("Yes.") steal the prior chapter's tail; a uniqueness gate over the whole export dropped tabs whose opener is echoed later. Enforced by: tests/test_anchor_split_and_holds.py::test_dialogue_line_is_not_an_anchor, tests/test_anchor_split_and_holds.py::test_epigraph_lands_in_its_own_tab, tests/test_anchor_split_and_holds.py::test_duplicate_opening_heading_stops_the_pull, tests/test_anchor_split_and_holds.py::test_opening_heading_inside_an_earlier_tab_stops_the_pull, tests/test_anchor_split_and_holds.py::test_tab_without_heading_stops_the_pull. (owner)
- `authorlm.terms`: Extraction and the developmental edit share this one implementation of the term rules, so the two cannot drift apart. (owner)
- `authorlm.terms`: The term index is built from the manuscript text alone, fresh on every call; nothing in the concept graph or `_concepts` notes is treated as authoritative. (owner)

## Agent-drafted

- `authorlm.devedit`: A verdict applies the item to the manuscript file only if the original text is still there exactly once; otherwise the item is stale and is checked again. Enforced by: tests/test_devedit.py::test_apply_refuses_changed_text.
- `authorlm.devedit`: An essay agent is given its essay's essay, section and paragraph summaries, the essay summaries of the essays already edited (later ones by title only), and the terms the edited essays established; it fetches anything else through authorlm verbs. (owner, 2026-11-09)
- `authorlm.devedit`: Essays are edited one at a time in reading order. One essay's pass is: findings, checks, the author's review, the accepted items applied, its summary rebuilt, then a notebook entry (`note`); the next essay's pack is refused until then (`--trial` excepted). The notebook is the shared memory: each agent's reasoning and the author's feedback, condensed on purpose, readable and correctable by the author. (owner, 2026-11-09)
- `authorlm.devedit`: Every agent works within the standing context: the file's style law (prose aspects only), the audience and market profiles and the example-arcs list; it reads manuscript text only through `read`, which serves covered files alone (author ruling 2026-11-09: nothing outside the final manuscript); the structural style law binds the proposals, sentence-level law waits for the line edit. Essay agents run one at a time in reading order, each given the arcs the earlier agents proposed. (owner, 2026-11-09)
- `authorlm.devedit`: Items are tiered must, should and could, with no cap. Every item is shown with a short reason (`why`, five to ten words); the full reason, the finding and the checker's note come when the author asks. (owner, 2026-11-09, replacing "the reason only when asked")
- `authorlm.devedit`: Nothing in authorlm's stored notes is authoritative: an essay's summary is rebuilt at the start of its pass and again after its items are applied, never the whole book up front; the term index is computed from the text. (owner, 2026-11-09)
- `authorlm.devedit`: The queue and the verdicts live in the workspace database beside `doc_threads`, written per row in transactions, safe for several agents at once; the documents stay files. (owner, 2026-11-13)
- `authorlm.devedit`: The term index grows with the edit: it is computed from the finished essays only, never the current or later ones. (owner, 2026-11-09)
- `authorlm.devedit`: Within a run the standard holds still: the ledger records every finding as addressed, declined, dropped or open; a rerun or a letter closes what was addressed and never reverses, re-raises or raises the bar on a closed finding. A new run starts with an empty ledger. (owner, 2026-11-09)
- `authorlm.docs`: A chapter has a stable identifier independent of the name the author sees, so it can be renamed cheaply: no record is lost or orphaned by a rename. Enforced by: tests/test_document_identity.py::RenameVerbTests::test_rename_carries_every_record_to_the_new_name and tests/test_document_identity.py::RenameOnDiskTests::test_a_rename_on_disk_heals_at_the_next_collect.
- `authorlm.docs`: `doc rename` is declined while the file is checked out to Google Docs, has a live filter run, a writeup in flight or pending forms: each holds state tied to the name while it runs. A rename made outside AuthorLM in one of those states cannot be declined and is carried all the same. Enforced by: tests/test_document_identity.py::RenameDeclinedTests.
